caption.text:
Teatime anyone🫖

Massive antique silverplate collection featuring Gorham, Reed & Barton, Wilcox, International Silver and other recognizable silver companies from the 1800s and early 1900s from what we can tell. Well over 50 different pieces and no idea what to do with a single one of them. 

What do we do with this pile? 🪎☕️🤷🏼‍♀️ #silver #antiques #collectibles #augustaga #joeandalx

Is it throwback Tuesday or Thursday? 🤷🏼‍♀️

Anyway, 3 years ago today I was sitting in the Olympic National Forest in the PNW with my best friend and not a care in the world surrounded by some of the best nature in the US. 

If you guys haven’t made it to the PNW in Washington yet- get there. It’ll change your whooooole perspective on life and if you guys need a spot to stay or recommendations on spots to hit- let us know- the Sea Shack is doooope🌲🚐🏔️ #travelinspiration #vanlife #joefelz

UPDATE!🚑🧙‍♀️🩹

Does this look better or are we still collectively thinking hospital?
